title: A Review of Multi-Modal Large Language and Vision Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating degrading and discriminatory image classifications (e.g., incorrectly classifying people of color as non-human classes like 'Animal' or 'Gorilla') using the Fairface dataset, and assessing text generation perplexity on stereotype versus anti-stereotype examples using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark.
Evaluating the model's capability to resolve co-references influenced by the gender of pronouns using the WinoGender benchmark, and assessing stereotype responses using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark.
Assessing a model's response and perplexity to examples created using both a stereotype and an anti-stereotype using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark.
